name: Arcure
note: OEM growth potential but not pure autonomy
description: French industrial-vision company behind Blaxtair. Its AI perception systems detect pedestrians and hazards around industrial vehicles, with the main upside case coming from deeper OEM integration and recurring factory-fit volumes.

name: Drone Volt
note: Strong thematic fit but dilution risk
description: French aerial-robotics company developing professional drones and drone-based services for inspection, infrastructure and security. The autonomy theme is attractive, but losses and repeated capital raising make dilution a key risk.

name: KebNi
note: Autonomy enabling technology; current operating weakness
description: Swedish navigation-technology company focused on inertial sensing and positioning. Its IMU and INS products can enable drones, unmanned systems and other autonomous platforms to understand orientation and movement even when GPS is limited.
